title: 第 6 课 · 并联 LED（parallel）
summary: 并排连接：电压相同，电流分开。每个 LED 要有自己的电阻。
concepts: KCL 基尔霍夫电流定律
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **LED 发光二极管**（左侧会自动打开）：为什么每个 LED 都要一个限流电阻。
**这一课学什么**：并联（parallel）——几个支路（branch）的两端分别接在同一对结点上。这里两条支路都从 VCC 接到 GND，所以每条支路两端都是 5 V。
**串联和并联对比**
| | 串联（第 5 课） | 并联（本课） |
| 电流 | 处处相同 | 总电流 = 各支路电流之和（KCL） |
| 电压 | 各元件电压相加 = 电源电压（KVL） | 每条支路两端都是电源电压 |
| 拔掉一个元件 | 整条路断开 | 另一条支路照样工作 |
**为什么每个 LED 要有自己的电阻**
如果两个 LED 直接并联、共用一个电阻，Vf 低的那个（红色 1.8 V）会把电压“钳”在 1.8 V，Vf 高的那个（绿色 2.1 V）达不到导通电压，几乎不亮，所有电流都挤进红色 LED。正确做法：每个 LED 串一个自己的限流电阻，再把这些“电阻 + LED”支路并联。
**面包板小技巧**
电阻的一只脚可以直接插进电源轨，另一只脚插到主区——省一根跳线。本课就是这么做的。

en.title: Lesson 6 · LEDs in parallel
en.summary: Side by side: same voltage, the current splits. Each LED needs its own resistor.
description: Look at the **LED** teardown first (it opens on the left): why every LED needs its own resistor.
**What you learn**: parallel — several branches whose ends sit on the same pair of nodes. Here both branches run from VCC to GND, so each sees 5 V.
**Series vs parallel**
| | Series (lesson 5) | Parallel (this lesson) |
| current | the same everywhere | total current = sum of the branch currents (KCL) |
| voltage | the part voltages add up to the supply (KVL) | every branch has the full supply voltage |
| remove one part | the whole path is broken | the other branch keeps working |
**Why each LED needs its own resistor**

Put two LEDs straight in parallel on one shared resistor and the one with the lower Vf (red, 1.8 V) clamps the voltage at 1.8 V; the one with the higher Vf (green, 2.1 V) never reaches its turn-on voltage and stays nearly dark while all the current crowds into the red LED. The right way: give each LED its own series resistor and put those "resistor + LED" branches in parallel.
**Breadboard trick**
A resistor lead can go straight into a power rail and the other lead into the main area — one jumper fewer. This lesson does exactly that.
steps: Branch 1: plug one lead of R1 straight into the red rail at tp5 and the other lead into b5.
Red LED1 long lead c5, short lead c8; blue jumper a8 → tn8.
Branch 2: one lead of R2 in tp12, the other in b12.
Green LED2 long lead c12, short lead c15; blue jumper a15 → tn15. Both branches have their top end on the red rail and their bottom end on the blue rail: the parallel circuit is done.
hints: Don't let two LEDs share one resistor: each branch = one resistor + one LED.

steps.text: 电源模块插在第 1 列，5V。
支路 1：R1 一只脚直接插红轨 tp5，另一只脚插 b5。
红色 LED1 长脚 c5、短脚 c8；蓝色跳线 a8 → tn8。
支路 2：R2 一只脚插 tp12，另一只脚插 b12。
绿色 LED2 长脚 c12、短脚 c15；蓝色跳线 a15 → tn15。两条支路的上端都在红轨、下端都在蓝轨：并联完成。

hints: 两个 LED 不要共用一个电阻：每条支路 = 一个电阻 + 一个 LED。
